prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, production-oriented robot sprite/motion reference sheet.
Asset type: ONE transparent RGBA 1536x1024 sheet, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of equal cells. Input image is the approved wheeled automaton family; borrow its family language and warm painted outlines, but draw ONLY the specified individual design consistently twelve times.
ROW 1: four clear neutral TURNAROUND views in order southeast/front-right, southwest/front-left, northeast/back-right, northwest/back-left. Show the genuine back with rear panels, not a face on its back.
ROW 2: four successive SE-facing ROLLING phases. Keep the same stable body, scale and camera; motion is wheel rotation, a very small soft body settle, gentle arm/tool response. Wheel spokes progress through four quarter-turn positions. These are not walking poses; wheels remain in contact with a common baseline.
ROW 3, all SE-facing: OFF (dim face eyes), IDLE (warm eyes), WORK START, WORK END. The two work poses show the simple job described below. Give distinct useful work states, mechanically attached limbs/tools and fixed wheel contacts.
Style: simplified rounded enamel shapes, cream/teal family accents, restrained brass rims and hubs, dark warm-brown outlines, softly painted shading like the provided family sheet, crisp at small game scale. Every robot has one round spark window; no mouth/nose or human face. Ground motion uses wheels with visible axles/hubs and a directly supported body, NEVER legs or shoes.
All twelve bodies must be the same character, same apparent size and wheel/tool design in their own cells. Leave roomy transparent gaps and fit the complete robot plus its tool within every cell. No ground shadows, background, scenery, grid lines, labels, lettering or pose numbers. The whole image has a genuinely transparent background; no paper or checkerboard. No duplicate family members, no Hotaru or humans.
INDIVIDUAL ROBOT DESIGN:
A compact red enamel POST-BOX robot, waist high to a human: softly rounded rectangular body, domed postal-red lid, one large round amber face window in a brass rim, two tiny glowing oval spark-eyes and NO mouth/nose. Below it two simple pigeonhole cubbies hold envelopes; a routine card slot sits under the lid. Two small red mitten hands on short solid arms, one plain canvas satchel attached to its side. The entire body sits DIRECTLY on a small teal rolling chassis with two large rubber wheels and one hidden little caster. No legs, boots, walking struts or floating body. Distinct post-box silhouette, small readable forms. WORK: lift an envelope from a cubby and place it into the open satchel.
